name: pinterest-mcp
description: Manage Pinterest boards, pins, and analytics directly from Claude.

appId.title: Pinterest App ID
appId.description: Your Pinterest App ID (from developers.pinterest.com). Required for OAuth authentication.

appSecret.title: Pinterest App Secret
appSecret.description: Your Pinterest App Secret. Required for OAuth authentication.

accessToken.title: Pinterest Access Token (optional)
accessToken.description: Direct access token for read-only use. Leave empty to use OAuth with App ID + Secret.

forceOauth.title: Force OAuth (optional)
forceOauth.description: Set to 'true' to always use OAuth even if an Access Token is set.
